entities.name: RRC
entities.description: Radio Resource Control layer in 3GPP specifications responsible for connection management, mobility, and security configuration.

entities.name: Lower layers
entities.description: Protocol layers below RRC that provide data transport services including security and reliability features.

entities.name: Integrity protection
entities.description: Service ensuring data authenticity and preventing tampering during transmission.

entities.name: Ciphering
entities.description: Service providing confidentiality by encrypting data during transmission.

entities.name: In-sequence delivery
entities.description: Service ensuring data is delivered in the correct order without duplication.

relations.description: RRC expects lower layers to provide security and reliability services.
Lower layers provide integrity protection as an expected service.
Lower layers provide ciphering as an expected service.
Lower layers provide in-sequence delivery without duplication as an expected service.
